## Total At Bat
total_at_bat <- df %>% 
  filter(event != 'BB') %>% 
  count(player_id) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n))

## Total HIT
total_hit <- df %>% 
  filter(event == 'HIT') %>% 
  count(player_id) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n))


batting_ave <- df %>% 
    mutate(
        total = event != "BB",
        hit = event == "HIT"
    ) %>% 
    group_by(player_name) %>% 
    summarise(
      AB = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
      H = sum(hit, na.rm = TRUE),
      AV = H/AB)  %>% 
  arrange(desc(H))

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

batting_avg <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Optional: standardize error label
    event = if_else(event == "E", "ROE", event),

    # AB rules (common): HIT, OUT, K, ROE count as AB
    is_ab  = event %in% c("HIT", "OUT", "K", "ROE"),
    is_hit = event == "HIT"
  ) %>%
  group_by(player_id, player_name) %>%
  summarise(
    AB = sum(is_ab, na.rm = TRUE),
    H  = sum(is_hit, na.rm = TRUE),
    BA = if_else(AB > 0, H / AB, NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(AB))
